short: Summability and a bound for the odd cohomology terms

lean.name: UpperTheory.Top.vvRecord
lean.plain: Summability and a bound for the odd cohomology terms
lean.note: For each prime and twist in range, the proof identifies the length stored in the lattice record with the actual Galois-cohomology length. It then transfers the host’s Sha bound to the record, giving a summable prime series with the same upper bound.
